name: Improved Shadowy Resistance
body:
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 7
You have developed a resistance to the life-sapping environment of the Shadow Plane.

Prerequisites: Fetchling, shadowy resistance racial trait.

Benefit: You gain resistance 5 against negative energy damage, do not lose hit points when you gain a negative level, and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, negative energy, and spells or spell-like abilities of the necromancy school.
